summary: BUUU Group Ltd, a BVI-incorporated Hong Kong-based filer, closed on September 15, 2026 its previously announced acquisition of a 60% equity interest in Brightray Science Inc., a prefabricated modular data center solutions provider, from seller DeedTech Inc. under a September 3, 2026 share purchase agreement. Consideration comprised 2,000,000 Class A shares at a fixed US$20.00 issue price plus a US$200,000,000 non-negotiable, non-transferable promissory note settleable solely in Class A shares at US$20.00, payable in annual installments tied to Brightray's net profit for fiscal years ending June 30, 2027, 2028 and 2029. Shares are locked up; BUUU holds a three-year call option on the remaining 40%. Post-closing, 18,847,500 shares outstanding; seller holds roughly 10.6% economic and 1.8% voting power. Watch earnout achievement, P-Note share dilution and 40% call exercise timing.
